# NexaForce Digital

> Berlin-based enterprise consultancy for Salesforce Cloud, n8n workflow automation, and Agentic AI engineering. 100% data ownership, zero vendor lock-in.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services): All consultancy services
- [Salesforce Sales Cloud](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/sales-cloud): Lead-to-Cash optimization, custom Apex/LWR, CPQ integration
- [B2B2C Commerce Cloud](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/commerce-cloud): Headless commerce storefronts, unified cart workflows
- [Salesforce Data Cloud](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/data-cloud): Real-time customer profiles, zero-copy architecture
- [Salesforce Health Cloud](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/health-cloud): HIPAA-compliant patient care coordination
- [Financial Services Cloud](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/financial-services-cloud): Wealth management and banking lifecycle automation
- [Revenue Cloud](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/revenue-cloud): CPQ and revenue lifecycle automation
- [Contract Lifecycle Management](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/contract-lifecycle-management): CLM automation
- [Enterprise n8n Automation](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/n8n): Self-hosted workflow engines, custom TypeScript nodes, queue-mode scaling
- [Agentic AI Engineering](https://nexaforcedigital.com/services/ai): LangChain/LangGraph multi-agent systems, RAG on pgvector, LangSmith observability
